text:
**Join our logistics startup as a Data Engineer**

We're a logistics startup of 60 people, and we just closed a $12M Series A. We need a Data Engineer to help us get packages where they need to go on time and on budget.

You'll work with dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow to build pipelines, improve our data models, and give teams across the company data they can trust. Because the company is small, your work will be visible from day one, and you'll have the autonomy to build your ideas without waiting on layers of approval.

The role is remote four days a week, with one day in the office for collaboration.

If you like solving complex problems and want to work on something that physically moves goods, we'd love to hear from you.
